Madhav Prasad Dobhal and Another
--Petitioners
Versus
R. Rajesh Kumar and Another
--Respondents
Hon’ble Pankaj Purohit, J.
Mr. Bhagwat Mehra, learned counsel for 
petitioners.
2. Mr. Devesh Ghildiyal, learned Brief Holder 
for the State of Uttarakhand.
3. Today, the matter is listed on 
impleadment application (IA/1/2026) moved 
by petitioners, whereby, petitioners want to 
implead new incumbents as respondent Nos.3 
and 4 in the array of parties.
4. There is no objection from the learned 
State Counsel.
5. Accordingly, the impleadment application 
(IA/1/2026) is allowed.
6. Let the necessary amendment be 
incorporated by filing amended memo of 
parties within 03 days.
7. If the amended memo of parties is filed 
within 03 days, Office is directed to issue 
notice to newly impleaded respondent Nos.3 
and 4 returnable within four weeks. Steps for 
which be taken within 03 days thereafter.
8. Put up on 03.11.2026.
 (Pankaj Purohit, J.)
 09.09.2026
PN
